content.short: Paradex is a high-performance perpetual futures DEX on its own Starknet L2, offering CEX-like trading speed.
content.description:
Paradex is a premier decentralized perpetual futures exchange built on its own dedicated app-chain powered by Starknet technology. Designed to bridge the performance gap between centralized and decentralized venues, the platform utilizes an off-chain order book for ultra-fast trade matching combined with secure on-chain settlement. Paradex provides a professional-grade trading experience with high throughput, deep liquidity, and a focus on user sovereignty through a non-custodial architecture.

A key feature of Paradex is its privacy-centric design, which hides specific position details and individual liquidation levels from public view to protect traders from predatory tactics. The protocol is powered by the $DIME token and supports a wide range of assets with professional-grade risk management. Through its commitment to technological innovation and high-frequency execution, Paradex is building the essential infrastructure for the next generation of decentralized derivatives, empowering participants to trade with professional-grade speed and precision.
content.meta: Paradex offers high-speed decentralized perpetual futures trading and privacy-focused execution on Starknet.
